tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. The official DevFest Off White in light, Black 02 in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Frames and cards that sit on `surface`: session cards, the margin column, form fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and every outline on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Also the 2px contour around glyphs, pills and frames.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (speaker roles, room names, captions, margin notes) on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules only: the Fibonacci grid seams and the margin column rule. Never a control border; controls use `ink`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Google blue, made vivid. The Call for Speakers box and field, Fibonacci tiles, the Web track. Text on it is `on-blue` (white, 4.9:1).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Google green, made vivid. Small Fibonacci squares and the Mobile track. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Google yellow, made vivid. The DevFest braces, the Call for Sponsors box, the tickets field, the Cloud track. Text on it is `on-pastel`. Never text on `surface`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Google red, made vivid. The rubric colour: one key number per layout (the year, the next session) at 34px and up, small Fibonacci squares, the AI track. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Links and small blue text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Small rubric text (an annotation, a 'sold out' word) on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: halftone-blue
tokens.usage: Halftone accent for glyph fills and secondary tiles. Shapes only, never text.

tokens.name: halftone-green
tokens.usage: Halftone accent for glyph fills and secondary tiles. Shapes only.

tokens.name: halftone-yellow
tokens.usage: Halftone accent for glyph fills and secondary tiles. Shapes only.

tokens.name: halftone-red
tokens.usage: Halftone pink for glyph fills (the brand's `>` `<` and `×` glyphs). Shapes only.

tokens.name: pastel-blue
tokens.usage: Track chip and tile fill for Web. Text on it is always `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: pastel-green
tokens.usage: Track chip and tile fill for Mobile. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: pastel-yellow
tokens.usage: Track chip and tile fill for Cloud. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: pastel-red
tokens.usage: Track chip and tile fill for AI. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text and outline on any pastel, halftone, `green`, `yellow` or `red` fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on `blue` fills: the Call for Speakers box and field (4.9:1).

tokens.name: reveal
tokens.usage: Background of the hidden face of a CallBox (the curtain or the back of the flip), in both themes. Text on it is `surface` (#f0f0f0).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

families.mono: "Google Sans Code", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: numeral-144
styles.usage: The year or the event date on posters, the site hero and the ledwall. One per layout.

styles.name: numeral-89
styles.usage: Big figures in a StatStrip (500+, 30+), distances on the venue strip, the year on social posts.

styles.name: numeral-55
styles.usage: Session start times in the agenda and on speaker cards.

styles.name: numeral-34
styles.usage: Sequence terms inside Fibonacci tiles and the Sequence band.

styles.name: heading-55
styles.usage: Section titles on the site (plain words, no numbering) and slide titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A day of talks and workshops by the community, in the city that brought numbers to Europe.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Talks run in two halls; workshops need a laptop.
styles.usage: Running text. 16px is the one size off the Fibonacci scale, kept for legibility.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles: room, length, level.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, margin notes, line numbers, ticket IDs.

spacing.note: The Fibonacci sequence is the spacing scale. Each step is the sum of the two before it.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Outline width, the gap between a glyph and its contour.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chip and button vertical padding; gap inside a meta line.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines of a card; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-21
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page; Fibonacci grid unit on phones.

tokens.name: space-55
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop; Fibonacci grid unit on desktop.

tokens.name: space-89
tokens.usage: Space above a section title; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Fibonacci tiles. The squares stay square.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Inputs and small frames.

tokens.name: radius-21
tokens.usage: Rarely used now: the system is square. Keep for print signage frames that follow the kit templates.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, track chips and the PISA pill in the nav. Everything else is square.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: Structural borders: the hero tiling, StatStrips, full-bleed colour fields, the frame of placeholders. Also the spiral line.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Seams between Fibonacci squares, agenda rule lines, chips and outline buttons, always in `ink` (or `on-pastel` on a fill).

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Hairline rules in `hairline`.
